# dsh-model-rotation
**自定义模型自动切换 / Custom model rotation with automatic failover — for DeepSeek Harness.**

Define an ordered chain of models. When a member is rate-limited, or times out more than
`timeoutThr

eshold` times, the tour moves to the next member. When no third-party member is left,
it goes back a

nd re-tests the models that timed out in the first round. Finally the DSH platform
model catches eve

sts the models that timed out in the first round. Finally the DSH platform
model catches everything.

- **Ordered failover** — pick any models you have configured, in the order you want them tried.
- **

Rate limit → switch immediately**; timeouts are counted per model and only switch past the limit.
-

**Retest round** — models that merely timed out get a second chance before the chain is exhausted.
-
**DSH platform fallback** — a platform model of your choice (e.g. `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`

)
is the last resort, and it is sticky: it does not jump back the moment a third-party route revives

.
- **Picks up in the model picker** — every saved chain is published as a model under the
「模型自动切换」

provider, so you select it like any other model. Selecting anything else leaves
your requests comple

u select it like any other model. Selecting anything else leaves
your requests completely untouched.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → 模型自动切换** (or the plugin's own page under **Plugins**).
2. **新建组合**, type a name

, and add members — the picker searches by model id or name.
Reorder with ↑/↓; the order is the fail

over order.
3. Optionally pin a **DSH 兜底模型** — the platform model used when the whole chain is exhau

sted.
4. **保存组合**, then pick the chain by name in the model picker.

The card list shows every saved chain with its members, per-chain timeout limit, and whether it is
c

urrently usable. A member whose provider has no adapter in this installation is flagged
「当前不可用」 and
skipped by the tour instead of failing your request.
### Per-chain settings
| Setting | Meaning |
| 超时上限 | How many timeouts one member may hit before the tour moves on. `0` switches on the first on

e. |
| 短时限流原地重试 | Off by default. When on, a `429` that states a short wait is retried on the same m
odel instead of switching away at once — useful for providers that already rotate accounts behind on

e route. Quota exhaustion always switches immediately. |
| 最长等待 / 原地重试次数 | The wait ceiling (ms) and
how many in-place retries one route gets before it is marked dead. |
### Tools
The agent can drive the same state:

- `model_rotation_catalog` — every provider/model pair available in this installation
- `model_rotat

ion_set` — replace the active chain's members
- `model_rotation_status` — chains, live per-agent pha

se, decision log
- `model_rotation_reset` — forget failures and start the tour over
## State machine
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Failures the plugin does not own (`SERVER`, `TRANSPORT`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, …) are handed back to
the
harness's own retry policy untouched.

Runtime state lives in `~/.dsh/model-auto-switch-state.json` (or `$DSH_HOME`), and is
best-effort: a
broken file falls back to the plugin config instead of failing the boot.
### About 「自动识图」

The harness registers a `-vision` twin for every provider that supports image input; those twins
lis

t the *same* models and only differ in accepting images. The picker hides them by default —
turn on

**显示「自动识图」变体** if you want to add one. For everyday text work use the plain
entry (cheaper, same con
text); add the vision twin only when you actually send images.
## Compatibility with provider-level rotation

The plugin rewrites the route at the `agent/request` waterfall, which runs *before* the adapter is
b

ound. A member that itself rotates accounts behind one provider id (WorkBuddy, free-model pools,
…)

therefore keeps that behaviour — its own failover runs first, and only a failure of the whole
pool r

t behaviour — its own failover runs first, and only a failure of the whole
pool reaches this plugin.
